webscript.description:
Trades a verified OIDC access token for a Share session, so the supplier portal can run beCPG's form-resolution cascade — which only Share knows how to run, and which needs a session because the node-type config evaluator calls /api/metadata through the session connector.
OFF BY DEFAULT. Answers 404 until becpg.portal.session.enabled is set to true AND every mandatory value is configured (issuer, audiences, authorizedParties, sharedSecret, allowedAddresses). See fr.becpg.web.authentication.PortalSessionConfig.
POST only, and never GET: it creates a resource and must not be cached, prefetched or reachable from a link. Requires BOTH an Authorization: Bearer header and the X-beCPG-Portal-Key shared secret, and only answers callers whose direct address is in the configured allow list.
Prefer /share/noauth/becpg/portal/session over /share/service/becpg/portal/session: /noauth/* is mapped to the UrlRewriteFilter alone, so it is not challenged by the AIMS or SSO filters in any deployment mode. Safe here only because this endpoint derives no authority at all from cookies.
Additive endpoint: BeCPGAIMSFilter, web.xml and every existing bean are untouched.
